d: Freshly released UK government documents have shed new light on Peter Mandelson's attempts to sell his stake in lobbying firm Global Counsel while serving as Britain's ambassador to the United States. Mandelson reportedly rejected an initial buyout offer because he believed it undervalued his shares. As Foreign Office officials raised concerns over potential conflicts of interest, Mandelson later urged the firm to complete the purchase, writing that Global Counsel should "pull their fingers out and buy my shares".
